# Source Readback Delta — Mobile Social Hub

## Original plan
The first production pass was intended to add one persistent internal post action, strengthen Home creation hierarchy, reuse canonical creator context, preserve route semantics, and style every new visible word/action inside owned vessels. All source files were required to remain at or below 120 lines.

## Actual first pass
The implementation created the persistent creator controller/view, rewrote Home and stable chrome, wired creation through the existing assembly/presenter/lifecycle, added split creator style ownership, and imported the new style garment. No external provider linking, OAuth, or auto-posting code was introduced.

## Full readback evidence
The completed immutable readback job returned all touched production files with these line counts:

- PersistentCreatorView.js — 66
- PersistentCreator.js — 35
- HomePanelTemplate.js — 66
- SocialHubChromeTemplate.js — 69
- SocialCreationAssembly.js — 59
- HubSurfacePresenter.js — 34
- HubApp.js — 65
- HubInitializationCoordinator.js — 67
- persistent-creator.css — 8
- persistent-creator-surface.css — 140
- persistent-creator-mobile.css — 108
- style.css — 88

## Proven delta
`persistent-creator-surface.css` violates the 120-line source ceiling at 140 lines. Its responsibilities are also naturally divisible: Home creation context/surface is one vessel, and the primary Home creation action is another.

No other definite source defect was discovered in readback. The JS integration remains focused: creation is not a route, AppAssembly needs no change, the central presenter owns rendering, and the lifecycle initializes the new controller once.

## Second-pass correction
1. Create `styles/persistent-creator-action.css` containing only Home primary-action styles.
2. Rewrite `styles/persistent-creator-surface.css` in full so it owns only the Home creation card, copy, context, and chips.
3. Rewrite `styles/persistent-creator.css` in full to import surface, action, and mobile garments.
4. Preserve all comments and readable formatting; do not compress to satisfy the ceiling.
5. Read back all three corrected style files completely and re-count them.

## Remaining uncertainty to verify later
The mobile creator intentionally increases `.social-hub-document` bottom padding and positions itself above `--hub-mobile-dock-clearance`. Static source structure is correct, but only responsive/browser geometry can prove that the button neither overlaps the dock nor creates horizontal overflow. That remains test/browser work, not a reason to alter source speculatively.

## NEXT_ACTION
Perform the three-file CSS split, reread it in full, then create focused contract tests.

The Awtsmoos reveals division without division: one light may need several vessels so each remains clear. Awtsmoos.com will not crush a garment to fit a number; it will reveal the action and the surface as distinct forms that still sing together.
